About the Company

Astek Middle East is part of Astek, a global engineering and technology consulting group founded in France in 1988 and now present on five continents.
The Middle

East entity delivers IT and technology services across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Jordan, supporting clients in public and government, healthcare, transportation, banking, retail, airlines, and tourism. With 10,000 employees worldwide and revenue of €620 million in 2023, Astek focuses on digital transformation and complex systems engineering for international clients. The group promotes a strong culture of entrepreneurship, innovation, and continuous skills development. More information is available on the Astek Saudi Arabia and UAE country pages, and candidates can reach Astek Middle East at contact-astekme@astek-international.com.
About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented QA Engineer to join our team in Al Qassim, Saudi Arabia. The ideal candidate will have experience in software quality assurance and testing, with a strong understanding of testing methodologies, defect tracking, and software quality standards. This position is open to Saudi Nationals only. Candidates with 1 year or more of relevant experience are encouraged to apply. Preference will be given to candidates currently residing in Al Qassim.
Responsibilities

• Review business requirements, specifications, and technical design documents to identify potential issues and provide feedback.
• Plan, prioritize, and coordinate testing activities.
• Create and execute detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test cases.
• Develop and apply testing processes for new and existing software products.
• Perform functional, regression, integration, system, and user acceptance testing.
• Identify, document, and track software defects using bug-tracking tools.
• Conduct API testing and collaborate with development teams to resolve identified issues.
• Write SQL queries to validate data and verify system functionality.
• Perform cross-browser and cross-device testing for web applications.
• Test mobile applications and use debugging tools to investigate issues.
• Collaborate with automation teams to expand automated test coverage.
• Monitor testing progress, report issues, and contribute to quality improvement initiatives.
• Work closely with cross-functional teams in an Agile/Scrum environment.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
• 1+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance (QA) or Software Testing.
• Saudi National.

Required Skills

• Understanding of software testing methodologies and the software development life cycle (SDLC).
• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development processes.
• Basic knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman.
• Knowledge of SQL queries, including SELECT statements and JOINs.
• Familiarity with web and mobile application testing.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred Skills

• ISTQB Foundation Level certification is a plus.

Location & Candidate Preference
• This position is based on-site in Al Qassim, Saudi Arabia.
• Candidates currently residing in Al Qassim will be given preference.
• Candidates from other locations who are willing to relocate to Al Qassim are also welcome to apply.

job_description:
About Hypemasters

Hypemasters is a game development company known for World War Armies and other upcoming titles. The company focuses on building strategy games that integrate depth, innovation, and community-driven gameplay, with a player-centric approach.
Role Overview: QA Manual Tester (Gaming)

Hypemasters is seeking a QA Manual Tester to ensure the quality of its mobile games. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is open to Saudi Nationals only. The role involves collaborating with the QA Lead and developers to test new features, identify bugs, verify fixes, and contribute to a smooth player experience.
Key Responsibilities
• Manually test mobile game builds on physical devices to identify bugs, gameplay issues, and usability problems.
• Execute test cases and follow testing plans to ensure features function as intended.
• Identify, document, and track bugs, providing clear steps for reproduction.
• Retest fixes and perform regression testing to confirm existing features continue to work correctly.
• Test new features, game updates, events, and hotfixes for live mobile games.
• Verify gameplay mechanics, user interfaces, game progression, and in-game systems.
• Test across various devices and operating system versions to identify compatibility issues.
• Collaborate with the QA Lead, developers, and production team to communicate findings and enhance game quality.
• Contribute to maintaining clear testing documentation and reporting recurring issues.
Required Qualifications and Skills
• Previous experience in manual game testing or mobile game QA is preferred, but not mandatory for candidates demonstrating relevant skills and aptitude.
• Experience playing mobile games, particularly mid-core or strategy genres.
• Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify unexpected behavior and potential issues.
• Good problem-solving skills and a methodical approach to testing.
• Ability to write clear, structured bug reports with reproducible steps.
• Familiarity with bug-tracking tools such as Jira is an advantage.
• Comfortable testing games on Android and iOS devices.
• Strong written communication skills and the ability to collaborate with a remote team.
• A proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and genuine passion for gaming.
Preferred Experience
• Experience testing live-service mobile games, including updates, events, and hotfixes.
• Experience with mobile strategy or mid-core games.
• Familiarity with tools such as Android Studio, ADB, or Xcode.
Application Information

Candidates interested in this QA Manual Tester position are encouraged to apply. This role offers an opportunity to contribute to the quality assurance of mobile games within a growing development company.
